label: Every PURE_ACT_5 actual root has intrinsic self-knowledge
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every actual concrete root of the selected grounding relation at w that is in potency in no respect of the independently supplied potency predicate has intrinsic self-knowledge: some content about it and correct of it that it itself actually apprehends, with cognitive grounding. It does not say that any root is in pure act, that there is a root, or that the root knows anything other than itself.
